mara.activity: Wake, wash up, take my prescription if due, and get dressed for work. I bring my reading glasses from the living-room side table upstairs and set them on the left nightstand when I am finished with them.
mara.intention: Start quietly and avoid disturbing Daniel while getting ready.

mara.activity: Make coffee and toast, then check the weather and transit alerts on my phone at the kitchen island. I use the blue ceramic mug and leave it at the island center when I finish.
mara.intention: Follow my usual Friday morning routine while keeping track of any delays.

mara.activity: Finish getting ready, pack my work laptop into its padded backpack, and gather my wallet, keys, transit badge, and headphones. I put the keys in the maple console's left drawer before leaving.
mara.intention: Leave the house organized enough that I do not have to think about forgotten work items during the commute.
Arrive with enough time to settle before the workday.

mara.activity: Work at the municipal office on transportation planning, meetings, and reviewing street-project maps. I keep my phone available in case Daniel needs me, but avoid hovering over it during meetings.
mara.intention: Complete the Friday workday while staying reachable and keeping my attention from drifting into worry.

mara.activity: Commute home from the municipal office and stop for any necessary basic food on the way if the house does not have an easy dinner option.
mara.intention: Get home promptly without turning the evening into another demanding task.

mara.activity: Come in, put my work backpack in bedroom two, change into leggings and a cardigan, and check quietly on Daniel without pressing him to talk.
mara.intention: Re-enter the household gently and assess whether he seems worse than yesterday.

mara.activity: Make ginger tea and carry it to the right side of the living-room coffee table. I check whether Daniel needs water or medicine, then give him space rather than asking repeated questions.
mara.intention: Offer practical comfort and watch for signs that his illness is worsening.

mara.activity: Prepare a simple dinner for two, using a saucepan and pantry ingredients rather than expecting Daniel to cook. I set the dining table plainly and keep portions modest in case he has little appetite.
mara.intention: Make sure food is available without making dinner feel like an obligation for Daniel.

mara.activity: Eat dinner with Daniel at the dining table, keeping conversation light and allowing him to leave early if he feels worse. I carry my bowl, spoon, glass, and napkin back toward the kitchen when finished.
mara.intention: Maintain our usual shared dinner time while prioritizing his rest over conversation.

mara.activity: Wash the dinner things and do a small reset of the kitchen counter and entry. I check the tea on the coffee table and replace it with fresh ginger tea if it has gone cold.
mara.intention: Clear the most visible clutter so the evening feels calm and manageable.

mara.activity: Read my library book on the living-room sofa with tea nearby, keeping the television off or very quiet. I glance over periodically to check on Daniel without interrupting his rest.
mara.intention: Have a quiet decompression period while remaining attentive to him.

mara.activity: Put away the tea things, wash up, and prepare for bed. I put my phone on its charger and set a quiet reminder to check Daniel once more before sleep.
mara.intention: Close down the day without losing track of his condition.

mara.activity: Get into bed, read a few quiet pages, and turn out the light.
mara.intention: Rest enough for tomorrow while keeping the house quiet.

daniel.activity: Wake slowly, sit up, drink water, and use the bathroom. Wash my hands and face before returning to the bedroom.
Take allergy tablets and cold medicine with water if the label interval allows, then settle back under the quilt.
daniel.intention: Control the congestion and return to rest.

daniel.activity: Sleep or doze in bed with my phone and water within reach. Answer Mara briefly if she checks in before leaving.
daniel.intention: Let my body rest while Mara gets ready for work.

daniel.activity: Eat a small amount of yogurt and banana at the bedside, taking slow drinks between bites. Leave the bowl and spoon on the nightstand afterward.
daniel.intention: Get a little food down without provoking my stomach.

daniel.activity: Rest quietly in bed, keeping the room dim and using tissues as needed. Send Mara a short message that I have eaten.
daniel.intention: Stay comfortable while she is at work and avoid unnecessary activity.

daniel.activity: Get up carefully, carry the water bottle to the kitchen sink, refill it, and wash my hands. Put the used bowl and spoon in the sink.
daniel.intention: Hydrate and clear only the smallest amount of breakfast cleanup.

daniel.activity: Lie on the sofa with the throw blanket and quiet television, dozing on and off.
daniel.intention: Rest somewhere less confining without trying to resume normal work.

daniel.activity: Check my temperature and drink water. Take another dose of cold medicine only if the label interval has passed.
daniel.intention: Monitor whether the illness is easing and keep medicine within safe intervals.

daniel.activity: Sleep on the sofa with the television off, leaving the phone and water bottle beside me.
daniel.intention: Conserve energy until Mara is home.

daniel.activity: Wake, wash my hands and face, and send Mara a brief update. Remain seated or reclined rather than trying to help with dinner.
daniel.intention: Be present enough to communicate without turning care into a task for her.

daniel.activity: Rest quietly on the sofa while Mara handles the evening practical work. Drink water when needed and keep conversation minimal.
daniel.intention: Let Mara take over without pretending I am well enough to help.

daniel.activity: Sit at the dining table for a small portion of dinner if my stomach allows, drinking water slowly. Stop eating if nausea returns.
daniel.intention: Share a little dinner and conversation with Mara without pushing myself.

daniel.activity: Carry my plate and fork to the kitchen sink, then return to the sofa and rest rather than attempting more cleanup.
daniel.intention: Handle my own dishes while keeping the effort limited.

daniel.activity: Rest on the sofa with low television, telling Mara if I need to lie down. Keep the remote and water within reach.
daniel.intention: Have quiet company without staying up for a normal Friday evening.

daniel.activity: Brush my teeth slowly, wash my hands and face, and take any permitted evening medicine with water.
daniel.intention: Complete basic hygiene and prepare for bed.

daniel.activity: Walk carefully back to the bedroom, place the water bottle, tissues, and phone beside the bed, and settle under the quilt.
daniel.intention: Set up everything needed for brief nighttime wake-ups.

daniel.activity: Sleep, waking only for water, medicine if permitted, or the bathroom.
daniel.intention: Give the illness another uninterrupted night to run its course.
